entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Incorrect code generation in Async Iterator for combinedTokens #81467

Closed

  • Semantic snippets: Inline statement snippets are not present if completion session is not triggered explicitly #75072
    18.3
  • When creating class library in VS, it reverts to block-scoped namespace #79231
    Backlog
  • [Project template] Blank line is not preserved after namespace when file has usings #59719
    Backlog
  • Semantic snippets: `interface` snippet prefix and more #65151
    18.3
  • The default #if code snippet always insert white space end of $selected$ #76116
    18.3
  • Editor doesn't respect tab indentation preference when inserting a code snippet #73642
    18.3
  • Semantic snippets don't fallback to VS options properly #71570
    18.3
  • Code completion doesn't adhere to indentation settings #58032
    18.3
  • Change in behavior in code snippet shortcuts #67741
    18.3
  • Style-Consistent Code Autocomplete #75126
    18.3
  • 'if' semantic snippet does not honor non-default brace placement at end of line #72481
    18.3
  • ctor shortcut access modifier #70800
    Backlog
  • cw shortcut has System at the front #69590
    18.3
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11227.08 #81463

PullRequests

Created

  • Simplify symbol kind checks #81470
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix exception in InlineMethodRefactoringProvider for recursive calls #81469
    VSCode
  • Fix incorrect code generation on async iterators #81468
    Area-Compilers, Community

Merged

  • Fix issue where we weren't offering snippets inline after an expression #81466
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Follow user naming preferences when generating type snippets #81465
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Fix 'use var' with forr/for snippets #81464

    Area-IDE
